Do not assume flood-fill or neighbor propagation: test motif translations when the grid visually consists of noisy background plus one seed object.

For the task pattern with color-8 separators, 2×3 tiles containing mostly color 3 and occasional color 2, emit 1 for a tile with at least two 2s and 3 otherwise.
5. For sparse colored diagonal markers on a zero field, identify the invariant of their parallel lines: constant row−column for down-right diagonals, or row+column for down-left diagonals.
